title: auth_integration_test.dart is fully subsumed by auth_repository_impl_test.dart

evidence.quote: class MockFirebaseAuthGateway extends Mock implements FirebaseAuthGateway {}
class MockFirebaseAuthGateway extends Mock implements FirebaseAuthGateway {}

why: auth_integration_test.dart's single 'end-to-end' test (sign in with email then sign out, asserting the mapped AppUser stream) re-derives, near line-for-line, the same mock setup as auth_repository_impl_test.dart and re-covers ground already split across that file's signInWithEmail/signOut/onAuthStateChanged groups. Both files mock the exact same two gateways with no other collaborator wired in, so this isn't really an integration test — it's a second, smaller unit-test file for the same class, adding no scenario the 536-line sibling doesn't already cover.
recommendation: Delete auth_integration_test.dart; if the multi-step subscribe-then-signIn-then-signOut stream sequencing is considered a distinct scenario worth keeping, fold it into auth_repository_impl_test.dart's onAuthStateChanged group instead of maintaining a separate file.
acceptance_criteria: auth_integration_test.dart removed (or its unique scenario merged) with no loss of asserted behavior
